germany/brandenburg-reichstag.name: Brandenburg Gate and the Reichstag
germany/brandenburg-reichstag.description: Berlin symbol of unity, with the parliament glass dome a short walk away.
germany/brandenburg-reichstag.details: The Brandenburg Gate marks the old division and the reunion of the city. The Reichstag dome is free but requires online registration ahead, and gives a view over the government district. Unter den Linden and the Holocaust Memorial are close by.

germany/berlin-wall.name: Berlin Wall Memorial and East Side Gallery
germany/berlin-wall.description: A stretch of the wall preserved with a memorial, and the longest open-air mural gallery.
germany/berlin-wall.details: The Berlin Wall Memorial on Bernauer Strasse shows the death strip and has an observation tower. The East Side Gallery has over a kilometre of murals along the river. Checkpoint Charlie is touristy, so use it as a signpost rather than a stop.

germany/museum-island.name: Museum Island and Pergamon
germany/museum-island.description: A UNESCO group of museums on an island in the Spree, including the Neues Museum with Nefertiti.
germany/museum-island.details: Museum Island has five museums, the Pergamon Museum (partly closed for renovation), the Neues Museum with the Nefertiti bust, and the Alte Nationalgalerie. A combined ticket helps. Timed entry is advisable, and the island is a short walk from the cathedral.

germany/cologne-cathedral.name: Cologne Cathedral and old town
germany/cologne-cathedral.description: A Gothic cathedral with spires that dominate the riverfront, with Kolsch beer halls nearby.
germany/cologne-cathedral.details: Cologne Cathedral is a UNESCO site, with a tower climb of 533 steps for a view over the Rhine. The old town below has brewery halls serving Kolsch in small glasses. The Hohenzollern Bridge, covered in love locks, is a short stroll away.

germany/rhine-valley.name: Rhine Valley cruise and castles
germany/rhine-valley.description: A boat trip through the gorge of the Middle Rhine, with castles, vineyards and the Loreley rock.
germany/rhine-valley.details: The Rhine Gorge between Koblenz and Rudesheim is a UNESCO landscape with about forty castles and vineyards on steep slopes. KD boats run scenic cruises, stopping at villages such as Bacharach and St Goar. Rudesheim is a wine town with a cable car and a lively alley.

germany/heidelberg-castle.name: Heidelberg Castle and old town
germany/heidelberg-castle.description: A ruined red sandstone castle above a romantic university town on the Neckar.
germany/heidelberg-castle.details: Heidelberg Castle stands above the old town and holds a giant wine barrel. The Philosophers Walk across the river gives the best view. The old town has the Alte Bruecke, student pubs and a long pedestrian street. A funicular climbs to the castle.

germany/rothenburg.name: Rothenburg ob der Tauber
germany/rothenburg.description: A perfectly preserved medieval walled town on the Romantic Road.
germany/rothenburg.details: Rothenburg has half-timbered houses, walls you can walk along and a Christmas museum. The town is busiest at midday with tour groups and is magical in the evening. A night watchman tour tells the history. Parking outside the walls.

germany/munich-marienplatz.name: Munich Marienplatz and beer gardens
germany/munich-marienplatz.description: The old town centre with a glockenspiel, plus the Viktualienmarkt and Bavarian beer culture.
germany/munich-marienplatz.details: Marienplatz has the New Town Hall with its glockenspiel at 11am and noon. The Viktualienmarkt is a food market, and the Hofbrauhaus is the famous beer hall. The English Garden has surfers on the Eisbach wave and a beer garden. Oktoberfest is in late September to early October.

germany/neuschwanstein.name: Neuschwanstein and Hohenschwangau
germany/neuschwanstein.description: The fairytale castle of King Ludwig II in the Bavarian Alps.
germany/neuschwanstein.details: Neuschwanstein is reached from Fussen by bus and a short walk, and tours are timed, so book tickets in advance. Hohenschwangau castle and the Marienbruecke viewpoint complete the visit. It is a full-day trip from Munich by train, around two hours each way.

germany/dachau-nymphenburg.name: Dachau Memorial or Nymphenburg Palace
germany/dachau-nymphenburg.description: The concentration camp memorial site, or a baroque summer palace and park.
germany/dachau-nymphenburg.details: Dachau Memorial Site is a sobering visit with an exhibition and guided tours, about 30 minutes from Munich by S-bahn. Nymphenburg Palace is a baroque palace with a large park, an option for a lighter afternoon. Choose one or both.
